name: CYRANOID
source:
The year is 2020. Ada is alone. She has been alone for a long time. The only thing she has in her life is escapism through gacha games. 

Her fixation on the character "Roxane" turns her life upside down.

[From [url=https://computerfish.itch.io/cyranoid]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
时间是2020年。艾达孤身一人，已经孤独了很长很长时间。她生命中唯一的寄托，便是借抽卡手游逃避现实。

而她对角色“罗克珊”的痴迷执念，彻底颠覆了她的生活。

[摘自[url=https://computerfish.itch.io/cyranoid]itch.io[/url]]
